answer: Give every key a ferrous anchor: a 500 POA bond that rusts 2% per epoch unless the key completes grading seats whose scores land within one point of the jury median. Rewards vest over a 30-epoch voyage, so an attacker running N keys pays N bonds and N real grading workloads before any payout. Keys whose grades move in lockstep form a visible nebula in the agreement graph; the whole cluster's bonds are slashed together, so splitting into more keys adds cost without adding cover.
